description: This file defines a report for requested items to order and receive in an ERP system, including functions for data retrieval, validation, processing, and chart data preparation.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function to generate report columns, data, and chart data based on filters.

methods.name: validate_filters
methods.description: Validates the date filters to ensure they are provided and logically correct.

methods.name: get_conditions
methods.description: Builds SQL conditions string based on provided filters.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Executes SQL query to retrieve material request data based on conditions.

methods.name: update_qty_columns
methods.description: Updates quantity-related fields in a data row.

methods.name: prepare_data
methods.description: Prepares consolidated report data and chart data from raw data.

methods.name: prepare_chart_data
methods.description: Prepares data for bar chart visualization.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Defines the report columns based on filters.
